record_semantics.node: One official role or designated routing pathway, not necessarily distinct recipient; same IDs as base registry refine existing contacts.
record_semantics.edge: Typed oversight/administrative/referral relationship; registry: prefix refers to prior registry ID. No inference of universal hierarchical control.
record_semantics.verification: Reviewed public source listing on research date, not delivery test or legal determination. Some links may change.

authority_records.office: White House Office of Presidential Correspondence
authority_records.purpose: Federal policy concerns or appropriate agency referral.
authority_records.limits: Not a criminal complaint or court appeal; agency assistance requires individual authorization and review.

authority_records.office: United States Attorney General / Department of Justice

channel.mail: U.S. Department of Justice, 950 Pennsylvania Avenue NW, Washington, DC 20530-0001

authority_records.purpose: Request routing to responsible DOJ component.
authority_records.limits: Use civil rights intake for a formal civil rights report; general correspondence is not formal service.

authority_records.office: Department of Justice Civil Rights Division
authority_records.purpose: Report possible federally actionable civil rights violations.
authority_records.limits: Not personal counsel. A filed report does not establish a violation.

authority_records.office: DOJ crime and complaint routing
authority_records.purpose: Select competent federal investigative channel if facts implicate federal law.
authority_records.limits: Emergency: 911; state/local crimes ordinarily go to local law enforcement.

authority_records.office: U.S. Attorney Northern District of California – Civil Rights Coordinator
authority_records.purpose: Evaluate or refer allegations of federal civil rights violations in the district.
authority_records.limits: Use DOJ civil rights reporting instructions; no personal representation.

authority_records.office: U.S. Attorney NDCA – San Francisco office

channel.mail: 450 Golden Gate Ave., P.O. Box 36055, San Francisco, CA 94102

authority_records.purpose: Local federal office for jurisdictional guidance; same district as Civil Rights Coordinator.
authority_records.limits: Not a separate civil rights filing; follow coordinator instructions. Do not use media inbox.

authority_records.office: U.S. Attorney NDCA – Oakland office
authority_records.purpose: Local federal office for jurisdictional guidance; same district as Civil Rights Coordinator.
authority_records.limits: Not a separate civil rights filing; follow coordinator instructions. Do not use media inbox.

authority_records.office: U.S. Attorney NDCA – San Jose office

channel.mail: 60 South Market St., Suite 1200, San Jose, CA 95113

authority_records.purpose: Local federal office for jurisdictional guidance; same district as Civil Rights Coordinator.
authority_records.limits: Not a separate civil rights filing; follow coordinator instructions. Do not use media inbox.

authority_records.office: U.S. Attorney Eastern District of California – Civil Division
authority_records.purpose: Federal affirmative civil enforcement within EDCA.
authority_records.limits: Use postal correspondence or appropriate DOJ intake; webmaster cannot accept case material.

authority_records.office: U.S. Attorney EDCA – Fresno office
authority_records.scope: Fresno, Inyo, Kern, Kings, Madera, Mariposa, Merced, Tulare, Tuolumne
authority_records.purpose: Federal matters with local venue; contact for routing.

authority_records.office: U.S. Attorney Central District of California – Civil Rights Section
authority_records.scope: Los Angeles, Orange, Riverside, San Bernardino, Ventura, Santa Barbara, San Luis Obispo counties
authority_records.purpose: Civil rights issues only when facts establish venue in the district.
authority_records.limits: Civil section does not handle criminal matters or other districts.

authority_records.office: HHS Secretary / Executive Secretariat

channel.mail: U.S. Department of Health and Human Services, 200 Independence Avenue SW, Washington, DC 20201

authority_records.purpose: Systemic healthcare policy and agency coordination concerns.
authority_records.limits: For a specific discrimination allegation use OCR; personal medical records through secure intake.

authority_records.office: HHS Office for Civil Rights
authority_records.purpose: Health-care discrimination and civil rights enforcement.
authority_records.limits: Use prescribed complaint procedure; check time limits and good-cause extensions.

authority_records.office: HHS OCR – health information privacy
authority_records.purpose: HIPAA or other OCR-covered health information concerns.
authority_records.limits: Distinguish record accuracy disputes from a HIPAA violation.

authority_records.office: HHS OCR San Francisco field office
authority_records.purpose: Regional contact; use national OCR intake for routing.

authority_records.office: U.S. Senator Alex Padilla – constituent assistance
authority_records.purpose: Request federal agency liaison assistance or raise systemic federal oversight concerns.
authority_records.limits: Cannot act on state/county agencies or direct litigation; complete required privacy release privately.

authority_records.office: U.S. Senator Adam Schiff – constituent assistance
authority_records.purpose: Request federal agency assistance using signed authorization.
authority_records.limits: Published email is for completed casework release forms; follow secure instructions; not a generic mass-mail address.

authority_records.office: U.S. House constituent representative locator
authority_records.purpose: Identify current representative by residence and use their designated constituent services.
authority_records.limits: No central representative email directory; current Congress ends Jan 2, 2027. Verify boundaries for next Congress.

authority_records.office: U.S. House CA-21 – Rep. Jim Costa, Fresno district office
authority_records.purpose: Constituent assistance with federal agencies; verify residence district first.
authority_records.limits: Does not override agency decisions. Do not assume CA-21 from city alone.

authority_records.office: House Energy and Commerce Committee

channel.mail: 2125 Rayburn House Office Building, Washington, DC 20515

authority_records.purpose: Legislative oversight of health care and federal health regulation.
authority_records.limits: Systemic policy oversight, not individual adjudication.

authority_records.office: House Energy and Commerce – Health Subcommittee
authority_records.purpose: Health policy, HHS, Medicare/Medicaid, malpractice and health information policy.
authority_records.limits: Use committee route; do not individually contact every member.

authority_records.office: House Energy and Commerce – Oversight and Investigations
authority_records.purpose: Review potential systemic shortcomings within committee jurisdiction.

authority_records.office: House Judiciary Committee

channel.mail: 2138 Rayburn House Office Building, Washington, DC 20515

authority_records.purpose: Federal justice and civil rights policy oversight.
authority_records.limits: Not a complaint intake for individual prosecution or a judicial appeal.

authority_records.office: Senate Health, Education, Labor and Pensions Committee
authority_records.purpose: Health, public welfare, disability and HHS oversight; chair and ranking member listed on source.
authority_records.limits: Committee policy inquiry, not a casework or medical complaint office.

authority_records.office: Senate Judiciary – Constitution Subcommittee
authority_records.purpose: DOJ Civil Rights Division oversight and constitutional/statutory rights.
authority_records.limits: Policy oversight only, not court or prosecutor.

authority_records.office: California Governor's Office
authority_records.purpose: Ask for referral of systemic health and justice concerns to competent state officials.
authority_records.limits: No email attachments; use mail if needed. Not a substitute for filing with an enforcement agency.

authority_records.office: Governor's cabinet – health and human services / justice and public safety
authority_records.purpose: Executive coordination through the Governor's constituent contact channel.
authority_records.limits: Cabinet coordination not direct supervision of the independently elected Attorney General in all matters.

authority_records.office: California Attorney General / DOJ Public Inquiry
authority_records.purpose: Submit concern and request evaluation of applicable state enforcement authority.
authority_records.limits: Does not provide personal legal representation; local criminal reports ordinarily start with police/sheriff.

authority_records.office: California DOJ Disability Rights Bureau
authority_records.purpose: Review evidence of systemic disability discrimination or pattern/practice.
authority_records.limits: Individual complaints go to CRD; bureau does not handle isolated violations or matters against state-level public entities.

authority_records.office: California DOJ Division of Medi-Cal Fraud and Elder Abuse
authority_records.purpose: Report suspected dependent-adult/elder abuse or Medi-Cal provider fraud within applicable jurisdiction.
authority_records.limits: Agency explicitly discourages AI-composed complaints; user should submit firsthand facts in their own words. Do not allege billing fraud without evidence.

authority_records.office: California Attorney General – local law enforcement complaints
authority_records.purpose: Escalation if allegations specifically concern police or sheriff misconduct and appropriate local remedies exhausted.
authority_records.limits: Not a substitute for an original crime report about a physician.

authority_records.office: California Health and Human Services Agency

authority_records.limits: Use formal agency-specific intake for complaints; email shown for records requests is not a complaint intake.

authority_records.office: Department of Consumer Affairs – Medical Board complaint route

authority_records.limits: Not a separate prosecution; submit facts and evidence to Board.

authority_records.limits: Select exact facility and incident; not all physician offices are licensed facilities.

authority_records.scope: San Luis Obispo, Santa Barbara, Ventura
authority_records.purpose: Investigate complaints against facilities under district oversight.
authority_records.limits: Use Cal Health Find to confirm exact facility and district before filing; not seven separate recipients for one incident.

authority_records.office: CDPH Licensing and Certification – Bakersfield district
authority_records.purpose: Investigate complaints against facilities under district oversight.
authority_records.limits: Use Cal Health Find to confirm exact facility and district before filing; not seven separate recipients for one incident.

authority_records.scope: Butte, Colusa, Glenn, Lassen, Modoc, Plumas, Shasta, Siskiyou, Sutter, Tehama, Trinity, Yuba
authority_records.purpose: Investigate complaints against facilities under district oversight.
authority_records.limits: Use Cal Health Find to confirm exact facility and district before filing; not seven separate recipients for one incident.

authority_records.office: California Department of Social Services – APS statewide routing
authority_records.purpose: Route report of suspected current dependent-adult abuse or neglect to competent county.
authority_records.limits: Not a separate complaint for all counties; use relevant ZIP.

authority_records.office: California Assembly and Senate district lookup
authority_records.purpose: Identify constituent state legislators and request state agency oversight assistance.
authority_records.limits: Confirm current district privately using address; do not publish residential information.

authority_records.office: Senate Health Committee
authority_records.purpose: Health facilities, insurance, public health and healthcare workforce policy.
authority_records.limits: Request policy oversight through committee or constituent member; do not submit sensitive records as public testimony.

authority_records.office: Senate Business, Professions and Economic Development Committee
authority_records.purpose: Professional licensing board oversight, including DCA regulatory boards.
authority_records.limits: Request policy oversight through committee or constituent member; do not submit sensitive records as public testimony.

authority_records.office: Senate Judiciary Committee
authority_records.purpose: Civil justice policy and legislation; not a judicial body.
authority_records.limits: Request policy oversight through committee or constituent member; do not submit sensitive records as public testimony.

authority_records.office: Assembly Health Committee
authority_records.purpose: Health care regulation and facility policy.
authority_records.limits: Request policy oversight through committee or constituent member; do not submit sensitive records as public testimony.

authority_records.office: Assembly Business and Professions Committee
authority_records.purpose: Physician licensing and oversight policy.
authority_records.limits: Request policy oversight through committee or constituent member; do not submit sensitive records as public testimony.

authority_records.office: Assembly Judiciary Committee
authority_records.purpose: Civil code, tort and evidence policy.
authority_records.limits: Request policy oversight through committee or constituent member; do not submit sensitive records as public testimony.

authority_records.office: Assembly Budget Subcommittee No. 1 on Health
authority_records.purpose: Fiscal oversight of CDPH, DHCS, DMHC and other health agencies.
authority_records.limits: Request policy oversight through committee or constituent member; do not submit sensitive records as public testimony.

authority_records.office: Assembly Budget Subcommittee No. 6 on Public Safety
authority_records.purpose: Fiscal oversight of state DOJ and public safety agencies.
authority_records.limits: Request policy oversight through committee or constituent member; do not submit sensitive records as public testimony.

authority_records.office: Joint Legislative Audit Committee
authority_records.purpose: Oversees public entities; legislators submit audit requests.
authority_records.limits: Ask a legislator to consider an audit of applicable public agencies; public testimony may become public record.

authority_records.office: California State Auditor
authority_records.purpose: Possible improper governmental activity or legislatively authorized audit.
authority_records.limits: Verify whistleblower jurisdiction; not a general private hospital grievance.

authority_records.office: Stanford Department of Public Safety – main campus
authority_records.purpose: Report alleged crime at actual Stanford campus incident location and request jurisdiction determination.
authority_records.limits: Shares dispatch with Palo Alto; do not duplicate the same incident report.

authority_records.office: Palo Alto Police Department
authority_records.purpose: Report alleged crime in city; call for incidents not eligible for minor-crime online reporting.
authority_records.limits: General department email not for crime reports or emergencies.

authority_records.office: Redwood City Police – Stanford Redwood City campus routing
authority_records.purpose: Report incident at Redwood City site if applicable.
authority_records.limits: Stanford's published dispatch instructions; do not refer unrelated incidents.

authority_records.office: Menlo Park police dispatch
authority_records.purpose: Report local incident if venue established.

authority_records.office: UCSF Police Department
authority_records.purpose: Report alleged crime at UCSF site; request accessibility accommodation.
authority_records.limits: For medical negligence or professional misconduct without facts suggesting crime, use licensing and grievance routes.

authority_records.office: San Francisco Police Department
authority_records.purpose: Report alleged crime in jurisdiction; contact nonemergency dispatch if not online eligible.

authority_records.office: Fresno Police Department
authority_records.purpose: Report local criminal conduct only; seek jurisdictional guidance if uncertain.
authority_records.limits: Fresno residency alone does not establish venue for Bay Area conduct.

authority_records.office: Fresno County Adult Protective Services
authority_records.purpose: Assess suspected ongoing dependent-adult neglect or abuse and local support/referrals.
authority_records.limits: If immediate physical danger or medical emergency call 911.

authority_records.office: San Francisco Adult Protective Services
authority_records.purpose: Assess suspected abuse/neglect within county jurisdiction.
authority_records.limits: Online reports only for nonurgent cases without physical abuse.

authority_records.office: Fresno County Board of Supervisors / Clerk
authority_records.purpose: Local social service and public health budget/policy oversight; constituent referral.
authority_records.limits: Not prosecution authority; avoid protected health information in public comments.

authority_records.office: Fresno County Department of Social Services administration
authority_records.purpose: Administrative escalation for county social services; APS intake remains primary.

authority_records.office: Stanford Health Care / Stanford Medicine Children's Health Office of Compliance and Privacy
authority_records.purpose: Code of conduct and compliance concerns through designated web report; distinguish from patient grievance.
authority_records.limits: Internal channel, not independent regulator.

authority_records.office: Stanford Health Care Medical Staff Office
authority_records.purpose: Ask Patient Relations for appropriate medical-staff leadership review and escalation.
authority_records.limits: Administrative office; not a substitute for Medical Board complaint.

authority_records.office: Stanford Health Care Board of Directors
authority_records.purpose: Request board-level patient safety and governance review through Patient Relations/compliance.
authority_records.listed_officeholder: Amit Sinha (board chair, roster as of 2026-09-01)
authority_records.limits: No individual director contact list; use institutional route.

authority_records.office: Stanford University Office of President
authority_records.purpose: University academic governance concerns; request appropriate institutional referral.
authority_records.limits: University and hospital legal entities differ; not independent clinical regulator.

authority_records.office: Stanford University Board of Trustees office
authority_records.purpose: University governance concerns via board office.
authority_records.limits: Use one board-office route; not direct supervision of each clinician.

authority_records.office: UCSF Health Patient Safety Hotline
authority_records.purpose: Current patient safety issue; parallel formal grievance as appropriate.

authority_records.office: UCSF Health Patient Relations
authority_records.purpose: Request independent grievance review, accessible communication and continuity of care.

authority_records.office: UCSF Office of Ethics and Compliance – Whistleblower Program
authority_records.purpose: Improper activities within whistleblower program jurisdiction; triage for appropriate review.
authority_records.limits: Email for questions; use designated hotline/form for complaint. Not ordinary clinical feedback.

authority_records.office: UCSF Health President/CEO and clinical leadership
authority_records.purpose: Request clinical governance escalation via designated Patient Relations office.
authority_records.limits: Do not distribute individual allegations to unrelated executives; use the official institutional route.

authority_records.office: University of California Board of Regents office

channel.mail: Office of the Secretary and Chief of Staff to the Regents, 1111 Franklin St., 12th floor, Oakland, CA 94607

authority_records.purpose: Board governance concerns regarding UC public institution and systemwide policy.
authority_records.limits: Correspondence may be public record; no confidential records. Not an adjudicator.

authority_records.office: Santa Clara County District Attorney
authority_records.purpose: Prosecutorial review or guidance after report to law enforcement; confirm venue.
authority_records.limits: Official directory distinguishes DA and victim services; 408-295-2656 is victim services, not DA main number.

authority_records.office: Santa Clara County DA Victim Services Unit
authority_records.purpose: Victim advocacy and local criminal justice referral.
authority_records.limits: Not a substitute for police report.

authority_records.office: San Mateo County District Attorney
authority_records.purpose: Prosecutorial review or guidance where facts establish venue.
authority_records.limits: Confirm local police report and appropriate unit.

authority_records.office: San Francisco District Attorney
authority_records.purpose: Prosecutorial review or guidance where facts establish venue.
authority_records.limits: General office contact; use local police for initial crime report.

authority_records.office: San Francisco DA Victim Services Division
authority_records.purpose: Victim support and advocacy.
authority_records.limits: Separate from prosecution and not a substitute for reporting.

authority_records.office: San Francisco DA Hate Crime Hotline
authority_records.purpose: Referral for possible bias-motivated crimes with local venue.
authority_records.limits: Discrimination alone does not establish criminal hate crime.

authority_records.office: California Civil Rights Department
authority_records.purpose: Individual civil rights complaint intake and investigation if within statutory jurisdiction.
authority_records.limits: Use official procedure; check applicable deadlines and accommodation requests.

authority_records.office: California Civil Rights Department accessibility assistance
authority_records.purpose: Request accessible communication and assistance with complaint process.
authority_records.limits: Not an independent complaint or duplicate case.

authority_records.office: California Senate Public Safety Committee
authority_records.purpose: Legislative policy concerning Penal Code and criminal procedure.
authority_records.limits: Use designated committee channel, not staff inboxes; policy oversight only.

authority_records.office: San Joaquin County DA Elder and Dependent Adult Abuse Unit
authority_records.purpose: Dependent adult abuse referral if facts establish venue.
authority_records.limits: Stanford affiliate status for this county requires recheck; do not send unrelated matters.
